style:
Cheerful children's picture-book cartoon illustration in a flat cel-shaded vector style (clearly a drawing, never a painting and never photo-realistic). Bold dark-plum outlines (color #2A1B3D) around every shape. Bold, warm, saturated colors with simple two-tone shading (one soft shadow tone per object, no realistic lighting, no photographic textures). Rounded, friendly shapes with a very slight hand-drawn wobble. Bright sunny daytime: light-blue sky fading to pale warm yellow at the horizon, puffy white clouds with the same dark outline, and a smiling sun with short rays in the upper right area, its center about 20% down from the top edge and fully visible (never cut off). Ground, water and backgrounds are clean color areas separated by a clear horizon line. The subject is drawn with accurate real-world proportions and ALL of its distinctive, recognizable features, large and clearly visible, not cut off. Keep the background simple so it never hides the subject. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no border, no vignette, no rounded corners (real inscriptions that belong to the place may stay small). Not a photograph, not 3D, not painterly, not blurry, not anime.

RECURRING TRAVEL TRIO (include in every image, always identical): three young travelers seen from behind in the bottom-left foreground, about 25% of the image height, facing the sight: (1) a boy in a bright blue T-shirt, tan straw sun hat with a dark-blue band and a big black backpack, taking a photo with a small black camera; (2) a girl with long brown hair, tan straw sun hat with a dark-blue band, orange-red T-shirt and a brown backpack, looking and pointing; (3) a smaller child in a blue baseball cap, green T-shirt and dark-gray backpack, pointing at the sight. They stand at the left edge, never cover the main subject, and for a close-up object or animal they stand a little behind or beside it, looking at it. All other people in the scene are tiny and simple.
format: Image size: 1536 x 1024 pixels, 3:2 landscape, full-bleed scene that fills the entire canvas (no transparency). Keep everything important inside the central 66% of the width and the central 70% of the height, because the game crops the image to a 2:1 banner and to a square thumbnail (the travel trio may sit near the left edge).
ref_note: The attached images are approved examples of the target style: copy their flat cartoon look, outline weight, colors, outlined clouds, smiling sun and the same recurring travel trio. Do NOT copy their subjects or composition.

items.label: Paris: Eiffeltårnet
items.subject: The Eiffel Tower in Paris, daytime: wrought-iron lattice tower in warm brown, tapering silhouette with four curved legs joined by a big arch underneath, three platforms, a tall antenna on top, green Champ de Mars lawn.

items.label: Kairo: Pyramidene i Giza
items.subject: The Pyramids of Giza: three pyramids in a row (the big Pyramid of Khufu, the middle one with a smooth stone cap on top, a smaller third one) on golden desert sand with a camel and a rider in front.

items.label: Tokyo: Fuji
items.subject: Mount Fuji: a perfectly symmetrical snow-capped cone volcano rising above a calm lake, pink cherry blossom branches in the foreground, blue sky.

items.label: Rio de Janeiro: Kristusstatuen
items.subject: Christ the Redeemer in Rio de Janeiro: a huge white Art Deco statue of Christ with arms stretched wide, standing on the Corcovado mountain peak with soft clouds, forested slopes, the bay and city far below.

items.label: Oslo: Operahuset
items.subject: Oslo Opera House: a white angular marble building with a long sloping flat roof that rises from the fjord like an iceberg, large glass facade at the front, tiny people walking on the sloping roof, calm Oslofjord water in front.

items.label: Oslo: Slottet
items.subject: The Royal Palace in Oslo: a pale yellow neoclassical palace on a hill with a central block, a columned portico with a balcony, long symmetrical wings, flat roof, Norwegian flag on top, a guard in front, green palace park.

items.label: Oslo: Holmenkollen
items.subject: Holmenkollen ski jump in Oslo: a tall white steel ski-jump tower with a long steep in-run curving down to a landing hill, spectator stands around the landing, pine forest hills, a hint of Oslo fjord in the distance.

items.label: Bergen: Bryggen
items.subject: Bryggen in Bergen: a row of narrow wooden warehouses with pointed gables facing the harbour, painted yellow, red, white and orange, a wooden quay with moored boats, a green mountain behind and a few raindrops in the sky.

items.label: Bergen: Fløibanen
items.subject: Fløibanen funicular in Bergen: a small red funicular car on a very steep track up Mount Fløyen, colorful houses and the harbour far below, forested mountainside.

items.label: Bergen: Fisketorget
items.subject: Fish market in Bergen harbour: market stalls with white tents, crates of fresh fish, shrimp and a big red crab on ice, a vendor in an apron, seagulls, the colorful harbour houses behind.

items.label: København: Den lille havfrue
items.subject: The Little Mermaid statue in Copenhagen: a small bronze mermaid with a green-tinted fish tail sitting on a boulder at the water edge, head tilted gently looking out to sea, calm harbour water, the city skyline far behind.

items.label: København: Tivoli
items.subject: Tivoli Gardens in Copenhagen: a Chinese-style pagoda pavilion with curved red roof, strings of lanterns, the old wooden roller coaster, flower beds and fountains, Danish flags, cheerful amusement park.

items.label: København: Nyhavn
items.subject: Nyhavn canal in Copenhagen: rows of tall narrow 17th-century townhouses painted yellow, red, blue and orange, old wooden sailing ships moored in the canal, cafe tables on the quay.

items.label: Stockholm: Gamla stan
items.subject: Gamla Stan in Stockholm: a narrow cobblestone street between tall ochre, orange and red buildings with steep roofs and old iron signs without text, the green copper spire of Riddarholmen Church rising behind, water glimpsed at the end.

items.label: Stockholm: Vasamuseet
items.subject: The Vasa warship in the Vasa Museum: a huge dark-brown 17th-century wooden warship with three tall masts, richly carved golden figures and lions on the high stern, rows of gun ports, displayed inside a big museum hall.

items.label: Stockholm: Kongeslottet
items.subject: The Royal Palace in Stockholm: a huge baroque palace in ochre-yellow and gray stone, perfectly symmetrical with a tall central block and wings, black iron gates, two soldiers on guard in blue uniforms, old cannons.

items.label: Rovaniemi: Julenissens landsby
items.subject: Santa Claus Village in Rovaniemi: snow-covered log cabins with red roofs, a friendly Santa Claus with white beard and red suit waving, a decorated Christmas tree, a reindeer sleigh, a line across the ground marking the Arctic Circle.

items.label: Rovaniemi: Nordlys
items.subject: Northern lights (aurora borealis): ribbons of green and purple light across a starry night sky above a snowy pine forest and a small warm-lit cabin. Night scene: replace the sun with a crescent moon and stars.

items.label: Rovaniemi: Reinsdyr
items.subject: Reindeer in Lapland: two reindeer with big branched antlers pulling a wooden sleigh through a snowy pine forest, harness with little bells, light snowfall.

items.label: London: Big Ben
items.subject: Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower) in London: tall Gothic Revival clock tower in golden-brown stone with four big clock faces, ornate pointed spire, attached to the Houses of Parliament next to Westminster Bridge, a red double-decker bus passing.

items.label: London: Tower Bridge
items.subject: Tower Bridge in London: two Gothic stone towers joined by high walkways, blue-painted suspension chains, the lower roadway bascules slightly lifted for a ship passing, the River Thames below.

items.label: London: Buckingham Palace
items.subject: Buckingham Palace: grand cream stone facade with a central balcony, Union Jack flag on the roof, black and gold iron gates, a guard in a red coat with a tall black bearskin hat, the golden Victoria Memorial in front.

items.label: Dublin: Kløver og rundtårn
items.subject: Ireland scene: a giant three-leaf green shamrock with a curved stem standing on rolling bright-green hills, an old gray stone Irish round tower with a conical roof on a hill behind, a stone wall.

items.label: Dublin: Trinity College
items.subject: Trinity College Dublin: gray stone Georgian front with an arched entrance, the tall Campanile bell tower in a cobbled square, green lawn, and a big old open book on a stand in the foreground (the Book of Kells) with colorful decorated pages and no readable text.

items.label: Dublin: Dublin Castle
items.subject: Dublin Castle: a round medieval stone tower with battlements (the Record Tower), Georgian castle wings in red brick and gray stone around a cobbled courtyard, the Irish tricolor flag.

items.label: Dublin: Kløveren
items.subject: A big three-leaf green shamrock with a short stem growing in bright green grass, a few small white daisies, a tiny leprechaun-free scene, gentle green hills behind.

items.label: Amsterdam: Vindmøller og kanaler
items.subject: Dutch scene: a traditional windmill with white sails beside a canal, narrow gabled canal houses on the other bank, a bicycle leaning on a bridge railing, red and yellow tulips in the foreground.

items.label: Amsterdam: Vindmøller
items.subject: A traditional Dutch windmill: brick or white tower with a rotating cap, four large lattice sails, a small wooden gallery, set on a flat green polder with a drainage canal and tulip fields.

items.label: Amsterdam: Syklene
items.subject: Bicycles in Amsterdam: many colorful city bikes parked along a canal bridge railing, one with a front basket of flowers, canal and tall narrow gabled houses behind.

items.label: Amsterdam: Rijksmuseum
items.subject: The Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam: a large red-brick neo-Gothic building with two corner towers, steep slate roofs, a big arched passage through the middle, a garden with a pond and tulips in front.

items.label: Berlin: Brandenburger Tor
items.subject: Brandenburg Gate in Berlin: a neoclassical sandstone gate with twelve Doric columns, five passages, a flat top crowned by the Quadriga (a chariot with four horses driven by the winged goddess Victoria), on a wide square.

items.label: Berlin: Berlinmuren
items.subject: A section of the Berlin Wall: a long concrete wall covered with colorful graffiti murals (hearts, abstract shapes, flowers, no readable text), a grassy strip and the Spree river beside it.

items.label: Berlin: Fjernsynstårnet
items.subject: Berlin TV Tower: a very tall slender concrete tower with a large silver sphere with windows near the top and a tall antenna spire above, city buildings of Alexanderplatz below.

items.label: Wien: Riesenrad
items.subject: The Riesenrad in Vienna: a giant red Ferris wheel with old red-and-wooden cabins hanging from its spokes, in the Prater amusement park with small booths and trees.

items.label: Wien: Schönbrunn
items.subject: Schönbrunn Palace in Vienna: a long baroque palace painted Schönbrunn yellow with white window frames and a green roof line, big formal garden with a fountain, and the Gloriette colonnade on the hill behind.

items.label: Wien: Statsoperaen
items.subject: Vienna State Opera: a neo-Renaissance cream stone building with a ground-floor arcade of arches, a loggia with arched windows, a green copper roof with statues, people walking in front.

items.label: Paris: Louvre
items.subject: The Louvre Palace in Paris: a grand stone palace with ornate carved facade, mansard roofs with dormer windows, statues and a large open courtyard; do NOT include the modern glass pyramid.

items.label: Paris: Notre-Dame
items.subject: Notre-Dame cathedral in Paris: a gray stone Gothic cathedral with two square towers on the west front, three arched portals with sculptures, a big round rose window, flying buttresses and a pointed spire on the roof, by the Seine.

items.label: Lisboa: Trikk 28
items.subject: Tram 28 in Lisbon: a vintage yellow tram climbing a narrow steep cobblestone street in Alfama between tile-covered buildings with laundry, overhead wires, orange tiled roofs and the Tagus river in the distance.

items.label: Lisboa: Belém-tårnet
items.subject: Belém Tower in Lisbon: a small white limestone fortress tower in Manueline style with battlements, rope-like stone carvings, round corner turrets, a covered terrace, standing at the edge of the Tagus river.

items.label: Lisboa: Klippfisk
items.subject: Bacalhau (dried salted cod) at a Portuguese market: stacks of flat split dried cod fish on a wooden stall, a vendor with a scale, blue and white azulejo tiles on the wall behind.

items.label: Barcelona: Sagrada Família
items.subject: Sagrada Família in Barcelona: Gaudí's basilica with many tall slender spires of different heights topped with colorful fruit-like pinnacles, the intricate drip-candle Nativity facade, pale sand-colored stone, a tower crane peeking behind.

items.label: Barcelona: Park Güell
items.subject: Park Güell in Barcelona: the colorful mosaic dragon-lizard (El Drac) fountain on a stone staircase, a wavy mosaic bench in bright tile fragments, a gingerbread-like pavilion with a wavy roof and a spire, palm trees.

items.label: Barcelona: Camp Nou
items.subject: Camp Nou football stadium: a huge oval stadium with steep curved stands filled with blue and dark-red seats, green pitch with white lines, light masts, blue sky; no logos or text.

items.label: Roma: Colosseum
items.subject: The Colosseum in Rome: a huge oval Roman amphitheater of cream travertine with three tiers of arches and an upper wall with square windows, one side broken away showing the inner arches.

items.label: Roma: Trevifontenen
items.subject: Trevi Fountain in Rome: a huge baroque fountain built into a palace facade, Neptune standing in the center on a shell chariot pulled by two sea horses, flowing water into a wide pool, tourists throwing coins.

items.label: Roma: Pantheon
items.subject: The Pantheon in Rome: a Roman temple front with sixteen giant gray granite columns and a triangular pediment, a big round brick dome behind it, with an obelisk fountain in the square in front.

items.label: Pisa: Det skjeve tårn
items.subject: The Leaning Tower of Pisa: a white marble cylindrical bell tower with eight stories of arched columns, clearly leaning to one side, on a green lawn, with a small bell chamber on top.

items.label: Pisa: Domkirken
items.subject: Pisa Cathedral: a church with a facade of white and gray striped marble with four tiers of arched columns, a dome, the leaning tower visible behind, green lawn of the Piazza dei Miracoli.

items.label: Pisa: Galileo
items.subject: Galileo Galilei: a friendly elderly scientist with long white hair and beard, a dark cap and robe, pointing a long brass telescope at a starry sky, the Leaning Tower of Pisa behind him.

items.label: Athen: Parthenon
items.subject: The Parthenon in Athens: an ancient Greek temple on the rocky Acropolis hill, eight Doric columns on the front, triangular pediment, honey-colored marble, some columns and roof parts missing, blue sky.

items.label: Athen: Det gamle stadion
items.subject: The Panathenaic Stadium in Athens: a horseshoe-shaped stadium made of white marble with rows of seats, a sand-colored running track, olive trees around and a blue sky.

items.label: Athen: Akropolismuseet
items.subject: Acropolis Museum in Athens: a modern glass and concrete museum with ancient marble statues (caryatid maidens in long robes) displayed in front, the Parthenon seen on the hill behind.

items.label: Istanbul: Hagia Sophia
items.subject: Hagia Sophia in Istanbul: a huge central dome with half-domes around it, ochre-pink walls with buttresses, four tall slender pencil-shaped minarets at the corners, a garden in front.

items.label: Istanbul: Storbasaren
items.subject: The Grand Bazaar in Istanbul: a covered market with arched ceilings and domes, hanging colorful mosaic lanterns, shelves of ceramics and rugs, spice piles, a friendly vendor in a vest.

items.label: Istanbul: Bosporos
items.subject: The Bosphorus strait in Istanbul: a ferry boat crossing the blue water, a big suspension bridge in the distance, Istanbul skyline with mosques and minarets on both shores, seagulls.

items.label: Moskva: Vasilijkatedralen
items.subject: Saint Basil's Cathedral in Moscow: nine colorful onion domes with spiral and striped patterns in red, green, yellow and blue, on a red-brick base with white details, on the cobblestones of Red Square.

items.label: Moskva: Kreml
items.subject: The Kremlin in Moscow: a long red-brick wall with swallowtail battlements and tall towers, the Spasskaya Tower with a big clock and a red star on a green spire, golden onion domes of cathedrals behind.

items.label: Moskva: Metroen
items.subject: A Moscow metro station: a grand arched marble hall with ornate chandeliers, mosaics on the ceiling, bronze statues between the arches, a blue-and-gray train waiting.

items.label: Reykjavik: Hallgrímskirkja
items.subject: Hallgrímskirkja church in Reykjavik: a white-gray concrete church with a very tall central tower and stepped side wings shaped like basalt columns, a statue of a Viking explorer in front.

items.label: Reykjavik: Geysir
items.subject: A geyser erupting in Iceland: a tall column of hot water and white steam shooting from a round pool in a steaming geothermal field with yellow-orange rocks, tourists watching from a safe distance.

items.label: Reykjavik: Nordlys
items.subject: Northern lights over the Icelandic coast: green and pink ribbons of light in a starry night sky above a dark mountain, a small red-roofed farm and the sea. Night scene: replace the sun with a crescent moon and stars.

items.label: Nuuk: Fargerike hus og isfjell
items.subject: Greenland scene: small red, yellow, blue and green wooden houses on a rocky hillside above a fjord, a big white-blue iceberg floating in the water, snow-capped mountains.

items.label: Nuuk: Fargerike hus
items.subject: Colorful houses in Nuuk: a cluster of small wooden houses painted red, yellow, blue and green on a rocky slope, with snow patches, a gravel road and a fjord behind.

items.label: Nuuk: Isfjell
items.subject: A huge iceberg in a Greenland fjord: a big white and blue-tinted iceberg with sculpted ridges and arches floating in dark blue water, a tiny fishing boat for scale, mountains behind.

items.label: Nuuk: Hvaler
items.subject: A humpback whale tail (fluke) rising above the water in a Greenland fjord with a small boat and mountains in the background, water drops, a few seabirds.

items.label: Kairo: Sfinksen
items.subject: The Great Sphinx of Giza: a huge stone statue with a lion's body lying down and a human head wearing the striped nemes headdress, the nose missing, a pyramid behind it in the desert.

items.label: Kairo: Museet
items.subject: Egyptian museum: the golden death mask of Tutankhamun (gold with blue-and-gold striped headdress, cobra and vulture on the forehead) displayed in a glass case in a museum hall, with a small mummy case and a statue beside it.

items.label: Marrakech: Koutoubia-moskeen
items.subject: The Koutoubia Mosque in Marrakech: a tall square sandstone minaret with decorative arch patterns and a small lantern tower topped with three golden balls, palm trees, pink-red city walls.

items.label: Marrakech: Jemaa el-Fnaa
items.subject: Jemaa el-Fnaa square in Marrakech: a busy square with orange juice carts, food stalls with colorful umbrellas, a snake charmer with a basket and a flute, musicians in robes, the minaret behind.

items.label: Marrakech: Atlasfjellene
items.subject: The High Atlas mountains in Morocco: snow-capped peaks above a Berber village of flat-roofed clay houses, walnut trees, a mule path, blue sky.

items.label: Nairobi: Safari
items.subject: Safari in Kenya: an open-roof safari jeep with excited tourists in hats, elephants, giraffes and zebras on the savanna, flat-topped acacia trees, a snow-capped Mount Kenya far away.

items.label: Nairobi: Nairobi nasjonalpark
items.subject: Nairobi National Park: a male lion with a big mane resting on yellow savanna grass, a flat-topped acacia tree, and the skyscrapers of the Nairobi skyline visible in the distance.

items.label: Nairobi: Sjiraffsenteret
items.subject: The Giraffe Centre in Nairobi: a tall Rothschild's giraffe (pale patches, white stockings on the legs) bending its long neck to a wooden feeding platform where a child holds out a handful of pellets.

items.label: Nairobi: Elefantbarnehjemmet
items.subject: Elephant orphanage in Nairobi: baby elephants drinking milk from big bottles held by keepers in green coats, red dust, a muddy waterhole, trees.

items.label: Zanzibar: Stone Town og dhow
items.subject: Zanzibar scene: traditional wooden dhow boats with triangular sails in the turquoise harbour, Stone Town waterfront with white coral-stone buildings and the white House of Wonders tower behind, palm trees.

items.label: Zanzibar: Stone Town
items.subject: An alley in Stone Town, Zanzibar: white coral-stone buildings with carved wooden balconies, a big dark carved wooden door with brass studs, a man on a bicycle, hanging flowers.

items.label: Zanzibar: Krydderfarmer
items.subject: A Zanzibar spice farm: a clove tree with small pink buds, a basket of vanilla pods, cinnamon sticks, black pepper vines and nutmeg, a farmer in a straw hat showing spices.

items.label: Zanzibar: Strendene
items.subject: A Zanzibar beach: soft white sand, turquoise shallow water, leaning coconut palms, a small wooden fishing dhow with a triangular sail near the shore.

items.label: Victoria Falls: Victoriafallene
items.subject: Victoria Falls: a very wide curtain of white water plunging into a deep gorge with huge clouds of mist, a rainbow in the spray, lush green rainforest, the Victoria Falls Bridge in the distance.

items.label: Victoria Falls: Regnbuene
items.subject: A double rainbow arching over the spray of Victoria Falls, white mist rising from the gorge, green trees on the edge.

items.label: Victoria Falls: Elefantene
items.subject: African elephants with big ears and tusks standing at the Zambezi river, a mother and a calf, the mist of the falls rising in the distance, green trees.

items.label: Kappstaden: Taffelfjellet
items.subject: Table Mountain in Cape Town: a flat-topped mountain with a white cloud "tablecloth" spilling over the edge, Lion's Head peak beside it, the city and harbour below, blue sea.

items.label: Kappstaden: Pingvinene
items.subject: African penguins on Boulders Beach: black-and-white penguins with pink patches above the eyes and a black chest band, standing among big round granite boulders on white sand, turquoise sea.

items.label: Kappstaden: Robben Island
items.subject: Robben Island near Cape Town: a low flat island with a white lighthouse and old gray prison buildings, a ferry boat crossing the blue bay, Table Mountain on the horizon.

items.label: Antananarivo: Lemurer og baobab
items.subject: Madagascar scene: two ring-tailed lemurs with long black-and-white striped tails sitting on a thick branch, huge bottle-shaped baobab trees along a red dirt road at sunset behind.

items.label: Antananarivo: Lemurene
items.subject: A ring-tailed lemur sitting upright sunbathing: gray fur, white belly, black eye patches around orange eyes, a long tail striped black and white, on a rock with green leaves.

items.label: Antananarivo: Baobabtrærne
items.subject: The Avenue of the Baobabs in Madagascar: giant bottle-shaped baobab trees with thick smooth trunks and small flat crowns of branches along a red dirt road, golden sunset.

items.label: Antananarivo: Rismarkene
items.subject: Rice terraces in Madagascar: stepped green rice paddies on a hillside, a farmer in a conical straw hat, red-brick houses with thatched roofs, blue sky.

items.label: Dubai: Burj Khalifa
items.subject: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai: the world's tallest skyscraper, a silver-blue glass tower tapering upward in stepped setbacks in a spiral Y-shape to a thin spire, with the Dubai fountain and lower skyscrapers around it.

items.label: Dubai: Ørkensafari
items.subject: Desert safari near Dubai: a 4x4 jeep driving over golden sand dunes, a camel with a rider on the next dune, a few palm trees at an oasis, blue sky.

items.label: Dubai: Palm Jumeirah
items.subject: Palm Jumeirah in Dubai seen from above: an artificial island shaped like a palm tree with a trunk and sixteen fronds, a crescent-shaped breakwater around it, the pink Atlantis hotel at the top, turquoise sea.

items.label: Agra: Taj Mahal
items.subject: The Taj Mahal in Agra: a white marble mausoleum with a big central onion dome, four small domed pavilions around it, a huge central arched entrance, four slender minarets at the corners, a long reflecting pool with cypress trees in front.

items.label: Agra: Agra fort
items.subject: Agra Fort: a massive red sandstone fort with tall crenellated walls, big arched gateway with towers, a moat, flags on top, a bit of the Taj Mahal visible far away.

items.label: Agra: Elefanter
items.subject: A decorated Indian elephant at a festival: gray elephant with small ears and painted patterns on the trunk and forehead, a colorful embroidered cloth on its back and a rider with a turban, tassels and bells.

items.label: Mumbai: Gateway of India
items.subject: The Gateway of India in Mumbai: a large yellow basalt triumphal arch with a big central archway and four small turrets on top, by the harbour with boats, the domed Taj hotel behind.

items.label: Mumbai: Bollywood
items.subject: Bollywood film set in Mumbai: a clapperboard (no readable text), a big old movie camera on a tripod, colorful dancers in Indian costumes in a dance pose, spotlights and a bright backdrop.

items.label: Mumbai: Lokaltogene
items.subject: A Mumbai suburban train: a long white and blue train with open doors, cheerful passengers hanging at the doors and windows, a busy platform with a vendor and a chai seller.

items.label: Kathmandu: Boudhanath
items.subject: Boudhanath stupa in Kathmandu: a huge white hemispherical dome with a golden square tower on top painted with Buddha's all-seeing blue eyes, thirteen gold steps in a tall spire, strings of colorful prayer flags radiating from the top, a monk walking around.

items.label: Kathmandu: Himalaya
items.subject: The Himalayas seen from Nepal: huge snow-covered peaks (Mount Everest massif) over green foothills, a small village with stone houses and terraced fields, clear blue sky.

items.label: Kathmandu: Bønneflagg
items.subject: Tibetan prayer flags: strings of small rectangular flags in blue, white, red, green and yellow fluttering between poles on a mountain pass, snowy Himalayan peaks behind.

items.label: Bangkok: Wat Arun
items.subject: Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn) in Bangkok: a tall central prang tower with a corn-cob shape decorated with colorful porcelain pieces, four smaller prangs around it, steep stairs, on the bank of the Chao Phraya river.

items.label: Bangkok: Flytende marked
items.subject: A floating market in Thailand: a long wooden boat full of fruit (mangoes, bananas, coconuts, dragon fruit) rowed by a woman in a conical straw hat on a narrow canal, other boats and wooden houses on stilts.

items.label: Bangkok: Tuk-tuk
items.subject: A Thai tuk-tuk: a small three-wheeled open taxi painted bright green and yellow with a canopy roof, a smiling driver and a passenger, a Bangkok street with other cars.

items.label: Siem Reap: Angkor Wat
items.subject: Angkor Wat in Cambodia: a sandstone temple with five lotus-bud shaped towers (the middle one tallest), a long stone causeway over a moat, reflection in the water, palm trees.

items.label: Siem Reap: Ta Prohm
items.subject: Ta Prohm temple in Cambodia: ancient stone temple ruins with gigantic silk-cotton tree roots wrapped over the walls and doorways, moss and green jungle light.

items.label: Siem Reap: Lotusblomster
items.subject: Pink lotus flowers in a pond: large pink lotus blossoms and big round green leaves on the water, a butterfly, a Khmer temple tower far in the background.

items.label: Singapore: Marina Bay Sands
items.subject: Marina Bay Sands in Singapore: three tall towers joined at the top by a long boat-shaped SkyPark with an infinity pool, the waterfront and the lotus-shaped ArtScience Museum, blue sky.

items.label: Singapore: Supertrærne
items.subject: The Supertrees at Gardens by the Bay in Singapore: tall tree-shaped vertical gardens with metal trunks and big umbrella-like canopies covered in colorful plants, a walkway between them.

items.label: Singapore: Merlion
items.subject: The Merlion in Singapore: a white statue with a lion's head and a fish body, spouting water from its mouth, by the bay with Marina Bay Sands behind.

items.label: Bali: Risterrasser og tempel
items.subject: Bali scene: curved green rice terraces on a hillside, a tiered Balinese temple shrine with a multi-layered thatched roof, tall coconut palms, a small offering basket in the front.

items.label: Bali: Risterrasser
items.subject: Rice terraces on Bali: curved stepped terraces of bright green rice following the shape of a hill, palm trees, a farmer in a conical hat, water shining in the paddies.

items.label: Bali: Templer
items.subject: A Balinese temple: a split gate (candi bentar) of carved gray stone, a multi-tiered shrine with a black thatched roof, small offerings of flowers and incense, frangipani trees.

items.label: Bali: Vulkaner
items.subject: Mount Agung volcano on Bali: a big cone-shaped volcano with a small plume of smoke at the top, green rice fields and palm trees in front, blue sky.

items.label: Beijing: Den kinesiske mur
items.subject: The Great Wall of China: a stone wall with crenellations and watchtowers winding along green mountain ridges into the distance, a few red autumn trees.

items.label: Beijing: Den forbudte by
items.subject: The Forbidden City in Beijing: a big palace hall with a double-layered golden-yellow glazed tile roof and red walls and columns, on a white marble terrace with stairs, a large stone courtyard, a bronze lion statue.

items.label: Beijing: Pandaer
items.subject: A giant panda sitting upright eating bamboo: black-and-white fur with black ears and eye patches, holding a bamboo stalk in its paws, green bamboo forest.

items.label: Ulaanbaatar: Ger-telt
items.subject: Mongolian gers on the steppe: round white felt tents with an orange painted wooden door and a stovepipe chimney, a small herd of horses, endless green grassland and gentle hills.

items.label: Ulaanbaatar: Djengis Khan
items.subject: The giant Genghis Khan equestrian statue in Mongolia: a huge shiny stainless-steel statue of a rider on a horse standing on a big round building on a grassy hill, the horse facing forward.

items.label: Ulaanbaatar: Hestene
items.subject: Mongolian horses galloping: stocky shaggy ponies in brown and white galloping across the steppe, a child rider in a traditional blue robe and hat, dust and grass.

items.label: Seoul: N Seoul Tower
items.subject: N Seoul Tower: a slender concrete tower with disc-shaped observation levels and an antenna, on top of the forested Namsan hill, autumn trees in red and orange, a fence of love padlocks in front.

items.label: Seoul: Gyeongbokgung
items.subject: Gyeongbokgung Palace in Seoul: a traditional Korean palace hall with multi-tiered curved tile roofs, colorful painted eaves in green and red, a stone platform with stairs, guards in colorful traditional uniforms, a granite mountain behind.

items.label: Seoul: Kimchi
items.subject: Korean kimchi: a brown clay jar (onggi) full of red spicy napa cabbage kimchi, chopsticks, a small plate of kimchi and a bowl of rice on a wooden table.

items.label: Tokyo: Shinkansen
items.subject: A Shinkansen bullet train in Japan: a long white train with a blue stripe and a long streamlined pointed nose speeding past, Mount Fuji in the distance.

items.label: Tokyo: Kirsebærblomster
items.subject: Cherry blossoms in a Tokyo park: trees full of pink flowers, petals falling, families having a picnic on blue mats under the trees, a pagoda and the tall Tokyo Skytree in the distance.

items.label: Sydney: Operahuset
items.subject: Sydney Opera House: a white building of overlapping sail-like curved roof shells covered with tiles, on a point in the harbour, the Sydney Harbour Bridge arch visible behind, blue water with ferries.

items.label: Sydney: Harbour Bridge
items.subject: Sydney Harbour Bridge: a large gray steel through-arch bridge (nicknamed the coathanger) with a rail and road deck, two stone pylons at the ends, small bridge climbers on the arch, a ferry and sailboats below.

items.label: Sydney: Kenguruer
items.subject: A red kangaroo standing upright on red dusty ground: strong tail, big hind legs, long ears, a small joey peeking from its pouch, eucalyptus trees behind.

items.label: Alice Springs: Uluru
items.subject: Uluru (Ayers Rock) in Australia: a massive smooth red-orange sandstone monolith with vertical grooves, rising alone from a flat red desert with green scrub, glowing at sunset.

items.label: Alice Springs: Outback
items.subject: The Australian outback: a red dirt road across a flat desert, a white-trunked ghost gum tree, termite mounds, spinifex grass, a road sign with a kangaroo silhouette, blue sky.

items.label: Alice Springs: Kenguruer
items.subject: A group of red kangaroos hopping across the red desert, one with a joey, spinifex grass and a ghost gum tree.

items.label: Auckland: Sky Tower
items.subject: The Sky Tower in Auckland: a very tall slender concrete tower with a round multi-level observation pod near the top and a tall antenna, Auckland skyline and harbour with sailboats below.

items.label: Auckland: Seilbåtene
items.subject: The City of Sails: many white sailboats on the blue Waitematā harbour, the Auckland skyline and Sky Tower behind, the volcano island Rangitoto in the distance.

items.label: Auckland: Vulkanene
items.subject: Rangitoto Island volcano near Auckland: a symmetrical shield volcano covered with green forest rising from the sea, a sailboat, a small ferry.

items.label: Honolulu: Diamond Head
items.subject: Diamond Head crater in Honolulu: a big volcanic cone with a crater rim and green slopes, Waikiki beach and hotels in front, blue ocean, palm trees.

items.label: Honolulu: Waikiki
items.subject: Waikiki Beach in Hawaii: golden sand, surfers on longboards riding gentle waves, an outrigger canoe on the beach, palm trees, Diamond Head crater behind.

items.label: Honolulu: Blomsterkrans
items.subject: A Hawaiian flower lei: a thick garland of pink and white plumeria and orange orchids with a ribbon, held out in front of a beach with palm trees and a turquoise sea.

items.label: New York: Frihetsgudinnen
items.subject: The Statue of Liberty in New York: a green copper statue of a robed woman holding a torch high in her right hand, crown with seven rays, a tablet in her left arm, on a stone pedestal on an island, Manhattan skyline behind.

items.label: New York: Central Park
items.subject: Central Park in New York: a pond with an arched stone bridge, autumn trees in red and yellow, a horse-drawn carriage on a path, skyscrapers rising behind the trees.

items.label: New York: Empire State Building
items.subject: The Empire State Building in New York: an Art Deco skyscraper with stepped setbacks, strong vertical stone lines, a tall mooring-mast spire on top, yellow taxis in the street below.

items.label: Washington: Det hvite hus
items.subject: The White House in Washington: a white neoclassical mansion with a columned portico with a triangular pediment, symmetrical windows, the American flag, green lawn and a fountain.

items.label: Washington: Washington-monumentet
items.subject: The Washington Monument: a very tall white marble obelisk with a pointed pyramid top, a circle of American flags around its base, a long reflecting pool, cherry blossoms.

items.label: Washington: Kongressbygningen
items.subject: The US Capitol in Washington: a white neoclassical building with a tall cast-iron dome topped by a statue, wide steps, a central columned portico and symmetrical wings, green lawn.

items.label: Los Angeles: Hollywood-skiltet
items.subject: The Hollywood Sign: giant white block letters spelling HOLLYWOOD on a dry brown hillside above Los Angeles, palm trees and blue sky (this is the only image where the letters are allowed).

items.label: Los Angeles: Walk of Fame
items.subject: Hollywood Walk of Fame: pink terrazzo sidewalk stars with brass rims and little film-camera and TV icons (no readable names), a red pagoda-style Chinese Theatre facade in the background.

items.label: Los Angeles: Santa Monica
items.subject: Santa Monica Pier: a wooden pier with a Ferris wheel and a roller coaster, a beach with palm trees and umbrellas, the Pacific ocean with waves.

items.label: San Francisco: Golden Gate Bridge
items.subject: The Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco: an orange-red Art Deco suspension bridge with two tall towers with horizontal braces, thick main cables, fog rolling in around the towers, green Marin hills.

items.label: San Francisco: Kabelbanene
items.subject: A San Francisco cable car: an open wooden trolley in red and cream with a bell, passengers hanging on the side, climbing a very steep street with the bay and Alcatraz island far below.

items.label: San Francisco: Alcatraz
items.subject: Alcatraz island in San Francisco Bay: a rocky island with a big gray prison building, a lighthouse and a water tower, a ferry boat approaching, the city skyline across the water.

items.label: Toronto: CN Tower
items.subject: The CN Tower in Toronto: a very tall slender concrete tower with a round pod near the top and a long antenna spire, the Toronto skyline and Lake Ontario, the white dome of a stadium beside it.

items.label: Toronto: Niagarafallene
items.subject: Niagara Falls: the curved Horseshoe Falls with huge white mist clouds, a small tour boat in red ponchos below, a rainbow and green trees.

items.label: Toronto: Ishockeymuseet
items.subject: Ice hockey: a big shiny silver trophy cup (the Stanley Cup) on a pedestal, crossed hockey sticks, a puck, a hockey helmet and skates on an ice rink.

items.label: Havana: Gamle biler
items.subject: Classic 1950s American cars in Havana: a pink convertible and a turquoise sedan with chrome bumpers and fins, parked on a street with pastel colonial buildings and palm trees.

items.label: Havana: Gamlebyen
items.subject: Old Havana: a plaza with a baroque cathedral with two uneven towers, cobblestones, pastel colonial buildings with arched arcades, palm trees and a street vendor.

items.label: Havana: Musikken
items.subject: Cuban street musicians: a band in bright shirts and hats playing a guitar, maracas, bongo drums and a trumpet, a couple dancing salsa, colorful colonial buildings behind.

items.label: Mexico by: Teotihuacan
items.subject: The Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan in Mexico: a huge stepped stone pyramid with a broad staircase, the Avenue of the Dead stretching in front, cactus and dry grass, blue sky.

items.label: Mexico by: Zócalo
items.subject: The Zócalo in Mexico City: a huge square with a giant Mexican flag on a tall flagpole, the baroque Metropolitan Cathedral with two bell towers on one side, the long National Palace on the other.

items.label: Mexico by: De dødes dag
items.subject: Day of the Dead in Mexico: a friendly decorated sugar skull with colorful flower patterns, orange marigold flowers, paper-cut banners (papel picado) with no text, candles and an altar with bread.

items.label: Quito: Ekvator-monumentet
items.subject: The Mitad del Mundo monument near Quito: a tall trapezoid stone tower with a big globe on top, a yellow line on the ground marking the equator, green Andes mountains behind.

items.label: Quito: Vulkanene
items.subject: Cotopaxi volcano in Ecuador: a perfect cone-shaped snow-capped volcano above a green Andean plain with llamas and yellow grass.

items.label: Quito: Gamlebyen
items.subject: Old Town Quito: white colonial buildings with red tile roofs, a baroque church with twin towers, the hill El Panecillo with the winged Virgin statue on top.

items.label: Manaus: Amazonas
items.subject: The Amazon rainforest: a dense green canopy of tall trees along a wide brown river, mist rising, a toucan on a branch and a small canoe.

items.label: Manaus: Elvemøtet
items.subject: The Meeting of Waters near Manaus: two rivers side by side, the dark almost black Rio Negro and the light sandy-brown Solimões, forming two colors on the water, a riverboat and forest on the bank.

items.label: Manaus: Papegøyene
items.subject: Scarlet macaws: two bright red, yellow and blue parrots with long tails sitting close together on a branch in the rainforest, big leaves.

items.label: Rio de Janeiro: Sukkertoppen
items.subject: Sugarloaf Mountain in Rio: a steep rounded granite peak rising from the sea, a red cable car on cables going up to it from the neighboring hill, Guanabara Bay.

items.label: Rio de Janeiro: Copacabana
items.subject: Copacabana beach in Rio: a long curved golden beach with the famous black-and-white wave-pattern pavement of the promenade, tall buildings, people playing beach volleyball, Sugarloaf at the end of the bay.

items.label: Lima: Machu Picchu
items.subject: Machu Picchu in Peru: an Inca stone citadel with green terraces and stone houses on a ridge, the steep Huayna Picchu peak rising behind, soft mist, a llama in the foreground.

items.label: Lima: Lamaene
items.subject: Llamas in the Andes: three fluffy llamas and an alpaca with colorful woven tassels in their ears, green mountains and a stone hut, blue sky.

items.label: Lima: Potetene
items.subject: Peruvian potatoes: a woven basket full of potatoes in many colors and shapes (purple, red, yellow, white), Andean mountains and terraces behind.

items.label: Buenos Aires: Obelisken
items.subject: The Obelisco in Buenos Aires: a tall white stone obelisk with a pointed top in the middle of a very wide avenue with many lanes, city buildings and trees around it, blue sky.

items.label: Buenos Aires: La Boca
items.subject: Caminito in La Boca, Buenos Aires: houses of corrugated metal painted in bright blue, yellow, red and green with colorful balconies, a small tango dancing statue, cobblestones.

items.label: Buenos Aires: Tango
items.subject: Tango in Buenos Aires: a couple dancing on a cobblestone street, the man in a dark suit and hat, the woman in a red dress, a bandoneón player beside them, colorful houses behind.

items.label: Hanoi: Ha Long-bukta
items.subject: Ha Long Bay: dozens of steep limestone karst islands covered in green vegetation rising from calm turquoise-green water, a traditional wooden junk boat with brown-orange batwing sails in the foreground, soft morning haze.

items.label: Hanoi: Mopedene
items.subject: A busy Hanoi street seen from a viewpoint: a stream of motorbikes, one rider carrying a huge basket of flowers on the back, riders in cone hats, narrow colorful shop-houses with balconies, tangled overhead cables, a yellow colonial-style building.

items.label: Hanoi: Pho
items.subject: A steaming bowl of Vietnamese pho: clear broth, flat rice noodles, slices of beef, green onions and fresh herbs, a lime wedge and chili on the side, chopsticks and a spoon, on a small table with low plastic stools at a street food stall.

items.label: Petra: Skattkammeret
items.subject: The Treasury (Al-Khazneh) in Petra: a grand two-level facade with tall columns, a round central tholos and a broken pediment carved directly into rose-pink sandstone cliff, seen at the end of a narrow canyon, a few tourists tiny at the bottom.

items.label: Petra: Wadi Rum
items.subject: Wadi Rum desert in Jordan: huge red sandstone mountains rising from flat red sand, a Bedouin tent with a campfire, a rider on a camel, a white jeep.

items.label: Petra: Dødehavet
items.subject: The Dead Sea: calm bright blue-green water with white salt crystals along the shore, a person floating on their back reading a newspaper, barren brown mountains behind.

items.label: Colombo: Sigiriya
items.subject: Sigiriya Lion Rock in Sri Lanka: a massive flat-topped rock fortress rising steeply from the jungle, a zigzag staircase and walkway up its side, ruins and trees on the summit, green forest all around.

items.label: Colombo: Teplantasjene
items.subject: Tea plantations in the hills of Sri Lanka: bright green neat rows of tea bushes on steep hillsides, women in colorful saris plucking leaves with baskets on their backs, misty mountains.

items.label: Colombo: Elefantene
items.subject: Asian elephants bathing in a river in Sri Lanka: a big elephant with small ears and a baby elephant splashing, a mahout sitting on one, palm trees on the bank.

items.label: Samarkand: Registan
items.subject: Registan Square in Samarkand: three grand madrasas with huge arched portals covered in blue, turquoise and gold tile patterns, ribbed turquoise domes and tall minarets, a wide open plaza with a few visitors.

items.label: Samarkand: Silkeveien
items.subject: The Silk Road: a caravan of camels loaded with colorful rolls of silk and spice sacks crossing a golden plain toward a distant walled city with blue domes, merchants in long robes walking beside them.

items.label: Samarkand: Samarkand-brød
items.subject: Samarkand bread at a market: stacks of round, flat, patterned breads, a baker in a cap pulling fresh bread from a round clay tandoor oven, a wooden stall.

items.label: Bohol: Sjokoladebakkene
items.subject: Chocolate Hills in Bohol, Philippines: hundreds of smooth, round, identical cone-shaped hills covered in brown dry grass spread across a green plain, seen from a viewing platform with a few visitors.

items.label: Bohol: Tarsieren
items.subject: A Philippine tarsier: a tiny primate with huge round eyes and big ears, long thin fingers gripping a tree branch, soft gray-brown fur, in a green forest.

items.label: Bohol: Delfinene
items.subject: Spinner dolphins leaping out of sparkling water next to a traditional Filipino outrigger boat (bangka) at sunrise, tourists waving from the boat.

items.label: Cartagena: Bymurene
items.subject: The stone city walls of Cartagena, Colombia: thick ramparts with a round lookout turret and old cannons facing the turquoise Caribbean sea, palm trees, a Colombian flag.

items.label: Cartagena: Fargerike hus
items.subject: A street in old Cartagena: colonial houses painted yellow, pink, turquoise and orange with wooden balconies overflowing with pink bougainvillea flowers, a horse-drawn carriage on cobblestones.

items.label: Cartagena: Fruktselgerne
items.subject: Fruit sellers in Cartagena: women in bright yellow, blue and red dresses balancing large bowls of tropical fruit (mango, pineapple, papaya, watermelon) on their heads in a plaza with colonial buildings.

items.label: Uyuni: Saltsletta
items.subject: Salar de Uyuni in Bolivia: an endless flat white salt flat covered by a thin layer of water that mirrors the blue sky and white clouds perfectly, hexagonal salt patterns near the foreground, a small white jeep with tourists far away.

items.label: Uyuni: Flamingoene
items.subject: Andean flamingos in Bolivia: a flock of pink flamingos standing on one leg in a shallow red-tinted lagoon with snow-capped volcanoes behind.

items.label: Uyuni: Togkirkegården
items.subject: The train cemetery near Uyuni: rusty old steam locomotives and railway wagons abandoned in the desert, a few kids climbing on them, clear blue sky.

items.label: Torres del Paine: Granittårnene
items.subject: Torres del Paine in Chilean Patagonia: three tall dark granite towers with sharp tips rising over a turquoise lake, light snow on the peaks, golden steppe grass in the foreground.

items.label: Torres del Paine: Grey-breen
items.subject: Grey Glacier in Patagonia: a huge blue-white glacier front reaching a gray-green lake with floating blue icebergs, mountains on both sides.

items.label: Torres del Paine: Guanakoene
items.subject: A herd of guanacos (slender light-brown camel relatives with white bellies and long necks) on the Patagonian steppe, the granite towers far in the background.

items.label: Galápagos: Kjempeskilpaddene
items.subject: A giant Galápagos tortoise with a huge domed brown shell, long wrinkled neck and thick scaly legs walking on green grass, a small finch perched on its shell.

items.label: Galápagos: Blåfotsulene
items.subject: Blue-footed boobies on volcanic rock in Galápagos: white-and-brown seabirds with bright blue feet performing a courtship dance, one lifting a foot.

items.label: Galápagos: Havleguanene
items.subject: Marine iguanas on black volcanic rocks beside ocean waves in Galápagos: dark gray spiky-backed iguanas piled together, one swimming in the water.

items.label: Iguazú: Iguazú-fallene
items.subject: Iguazú Falls: a huge horseshoe-shaped system of many waterfalls cascading over a cliff into a river in lush rainforest, thick mist and a rainbow, a walkway with a viewing platform and tiny tourists.

items.label: Iguazú: Tukanene
items.subject: A toco toucan with a huge orange-yellow beak with a black tip, black feathers and a white throat sitting on a branch in lush green jungle.

items.label: Iguazú: Båtturen
items.subject: A rubber speedboat full of passengers in orange life jackets right below the thundering Iguazú waterfalls, spray and mist everywhere, everyone laughing.

items.label: Dakar: Den rosa innsjøen
items.subject: Lac Retba, the pink lake near Dakar: bubblegum-pink water beside piles of white salt and pale sand, workers in colorful clothes with buckets, small wooden boats and baobab trees.

items.label: Dakar: Pirogene
items.subject: Pirogues in Senegal: long wooden fishing canoes painted in bright blue, red, yellow and green with patterns, lined up on a sandy beach, fishermen mending nets.

items.label: Dakar: Monumentet
items.subject: The African Renaissance Monument near Dakar: a gigantic bronze statue of a man, a woman and a child on top of a green hill, the man holding the child who points forward, wide steps leading up, blue sky.

items.label: Timbuktu: Leirmoskeen
items.subject: The Djinguereber Mosque in Timbuktu: a large sand-colored mud-brick mosque with a pyramid-shaped minaret and rows of wooden beams sticking out of the walls, desert sky, a few people in colorful robes in the sandy square.

items.label: Timbuktu: Karavanene
items.subject: A camel caravan crossing the Sahara: Tuareg riders in blue robes and turbans leading a long line of camels loaded with white salt slabs over golden sand dunes.

items.label: Timbuktu: Sahara
items.subject: The Sahara desert: endless golden sand dunes with wind ripples, a lone camel, a small tent and a campfire, a sunset-orange sky.

items.label: Lalibela: Fjellkirkene
items.subject: The Church of Saint George in Lalibela, Ethiopia: a cross-shaped church carved from one block of red-brown rock, sunk in a square pit, with three levels of arched windows and a cross-shaped roof seen from above, pilgrims in white robes standing around the edge of the pit.

items.label: Lalibela: Kaffeseremonien
items.subject: An Ethiopian coffee ceremony: a woman in a white dress pouring coffee from a black clay pot (jebena) into tiny cups, roasted beans in a pan, incense smoke, fresh grass spread on the floor, a bowl of popcorn.

items.label: Lalibela: Løperne
items.subject: Ethiopian long-distance runners training on a red dirt road in the green highlands, high knees and big smiles, mountains and eucalyptus trees behind.

items.label: Kigali: Fjellgorillaene
items.subject: A mountain gorilla: a big silverback gorilla sitting calmly in lush green bamboo forest with a baby gorilla beside it, misty green volcano behind.

items.label: Kigali: Vulkanene
items.subject: The Virunga volcanoes in Rwanda: cone-shaped green volcanoes rising above low clouds, terraced hillsides with small farms and banana trees in front.

items.label: Kigali: Trommerne
items.subject: Rwandan drummers: a group of men in traditional costume playing big wooden drums with sticks while dancing, colorful clothes, a green hillside behind.

items.label: Sossusvlei: Sanddynene
items.subject: The Namib desert dunes at Sossusvlei: towering red-orange sand dunes with sharp ridges, one side sunlit and the other in shadow, tiny hiker figures climbing a ridge, deep blue sky.

items.label: Sossusvlei: Deadvlei
items.subject: Deadvlei in Namibia: dead black camel thorn trees standing on a white cracked clay pan surrounded by tall red sand dunes, deep blue sky.

items.label: Sossusvlei: Oryksen
items.subject: Two oryx (gemsbok) antelopes with long straight horns and black-and-white face markings standing on red sand with dunes behind.

reminder: STYLE CHECK: flat cel-shaded cartoon with bold dark-plum outlines, outlined clouds and a smiling sun (center ~20% down from the top, fully visible), exactly like the approved images; never photo-realistic or painterly. Include the same three-child travel trio bottom-left. No text.
